sentences.text:
Author: K. Suresh Reddy
Bench: K. Suresh Reddy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K. Suresh Reddy
 Criminal Petition No.2119 Of 2020

ORDER:
(Heard and pronounced through Blue Jeans App (Virtual) mode, since this mode is adopted on account of prevalence of COVID-19 Pandemic)

The present Criminal Petition is filed seeking to quash part of FIR No.142 of 2018, dated 10.11.2018 on the file of Tripuranthakam police station,
Prakasam to the extent of offences under Sections 120 B, 273, 188, 420 r/w.34 of IPC and Section 20(b) of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 ("for short NDPS Act") and 59 and 63 of Food Safety Standard Act.

entities.text: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor.
3.
The issue in respect of the alleged offences is Food Safety Standard Act is squarely covered in terms of the Order in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch.

In view of the same the FIR No.142 of 2018 is quashed to the extent of the offences registered against the petitioner under Sections 120 B, 273, 188, 420 r/w.34 of IPC and 59 and 63 of Food Safety Standard Act.

In so far as the offences under sections 20(b) of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 are concerned, the same shall remain and the police are at liberty to proceed with investigation.

entities.text: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Accordingly, the Criminal petition is disposed of.
Consequently, Miscellaneous Petitions pending, if any, in the Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
